IFIP provided a collaborative and interactive space for Indigenous Peoples, Indigenous-led Funders and other funders in Asia to strengthen their partnership, hear indigenous perspectives and increase resources for Indigenous people. JASS delegates used the space to influence donors to increase resources to indigenous rights issues, particularly related to land rights. SEA Regional Director shared information about JASS' regional work with indigenous women such as the implementation of CMI's extractives toolkit. As such, JASS was able to secure a meeting with donors who were interested in supporting JASS' work. JASS also built connections with other indigenous rights organisations to explore building alliances for further expanding the use of CMI's toolkit. Future engagements with IFIP include collaborating for Women Deliver, CSW. and AWID international Forum.
